page.layout: One page of text. Above a rule: a verse epitaph in roman type, set across the full width. Below the rule: a centred title heading, then an italic verse epitaph. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Left edge of the scan is cropped, so the first letters of some top lines are cut off.

main_text.p: [?]efa nimis ac tenebricosa, erum corporea: ac proinde tali t divinum animum velut quibusdam [?]exum compedibus teneret arctis. At nunc coenobiique corporisque inclis Dampetrus exolutus exit, doctorumque volat per ora liber: Sui tamen moriens suis amicis heu, quot millia lacrymationum, heu, quot attulit anxios dolores! Non ergo occidit ipse quod putaram: occidit potius suos amicos.
main_text.head: CATHARINAE TEXEAE, Virginis Aurelienfis lectissimae, Memoriae.

p.i: [S]to quid iaceat loco sepultum, Forsan scire cupis, benigne Lector, Et hoc dicere perlibenter optem: Sed quo nomine debeat vocari, Quidquid hoc tumulo iacet sepultum Posse dicere, vix puto sagacem Virum, & quamlibet omnium peritum. Nam si ex corpore sexus aestimetur, Certe Virgo latet sepulchro in isto, At quanam ratione nuncupari Possit foemina, quam timore nemo

page.notes: The first letters of several top lines are cut off by the left edge of the scan; "[?]efa" and "[?]exum" are uncertain. The initial "S" of "Sto" is a large decorative letter. A black ornamental dot below the last line is not transcribed. Verse lines are run together within each stanza, with the line breaks not reproduced.
